policy: Existing nonthinking greedy/repetition1.0 original-source policy. No seed search or policy change.
criteria: All seven exact original ordered histories and full factual/citation/tool-attribution criteria unchanged. Completed rendering is not semantic acceptance.
stopping: One call per case. Stop first completed structural, validation, natural-completion or budget failure; remaining cases unrun. Otherwise complete seven and manually review every full criterion. No retries or repairs.
scope: Primary source evidence report is a separate treatment, not rewriting rejected narrative outputs. No production promotion or converted/runtime qualification.
launch: CPU4-7, four threads, nice10, x128, no GPU; prior source run is settled.
sourceReceiptValidation: Frozen loader verifies every download receipt file size and SHA256, exact revision URL, and expected LFS SHA256 before model loading; retained source-weight-binding.json lists config and both weight shards.
hypothesis: The retained 49-token response used scalar IDs and document strings while the prior schema required nested document objects. Test flat role-ID lists mapped by existing source provenance, with strict validation and no repair.
diagnosticScope: First case reused diagnostic; remaining six cases unrun in source-ledger treatment. No new independent model holdout claim.
limitations: Existing role vocabulary has no quantity multiplication. Printing-balance full criterion remains unchanged and may fail; no exemption.
Selected relation labels require full semantic review. No hidden entailment, omitted-condition assumption, or truthful prose inferred from quote match.
Renderer is unchanged and unresolved fields may fail usefulness requirements.

grammar.roles: All role fields required; flat unique source fact-ID arrays, max one per source document for base/depositBase/depositPercent/start/duration/completion.
grammar.relations: kind|passageId|factId or kind|passageId|-; kinds included/excluded/condition/conflict/unknown. Affected fact must occur in the named passage; - selects no affected numeric operand.
grammar.absence: Empty role list maps to empty list or null; no factual value inferred.
grammar.documents: Every actual document ID exactly once; provenance determines ownership of each fact.
